Class JsonNodeData

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.json.JsonNodeData
public final class JsonNodeData extends Object
Immutable value object carried as the user-object of every DefaultMutableTreeNode in the JSON tree.

Purpose

Rather than encoding type information in the label string and re-parsing it in the renderer, each node carries an explicit JsonNodeData.Kind tag. This lets JsonTreeCellRenderer select colors in a single switch without any string analysis.

Label format

toString() returns the string that JsonTreeCellRenderer passes to the underlying label. The format is:

  • Leaf nodes with a key — key: value (e.g. name: "Alice", count: 42)
  • Non-leaf key/index nodes — key summary (e.g. address {3 keys}, [0] [2 items])
  • Root node — the file name
  • Top-level primitives (no key) — the value string alone

  • Method Details

    • toString

      public String toString()
      Returns the display string used by JsonTreeCellRenderer.
      • Root: just the key (the file name).
      • No key (top-level primitive): just the value.
      • Otherwise: "key: value" for leaves or "key summary" for non-leaf keys.
